note: Local contracts, formularies, national and devolved routes and policy for each speciality, curated by hand from primary sources. HUMAN-CURATED: automation may only update lastCheck. Every item was read at its source on verifiedOn; `fact` states only what the source says, `quote` is copied from it, and anything the source does not settle says 'not verified'. scripts/check_speciality_local_intel.py re-checks every URL and records lastCheck; an item whose source is gone (404/410) is hidden by the renderer until it is re-sourced or removed. build_speciality_panels.py copies each speciality's list into its panel.

groups.nations: Scotland, Wales, Northern Ireland and Ireland

continence-bladder-and-bowel.title: Disposable and Washable Continence Care: suppliers by lot
continence-bladder-and-bowel.fact: Four lots. Lot 1 pants and shaped pads: Abena, Attends, Essity, Forma-Care, Healthcare 25, Paul Hartmann, Ontex. Lot 2 other disposables: the Lot 1 seven plus Meditrade UK and Sharon Services. Lot 3 washables: Abena, Attends, Essity, Forma-Care, GBUK, iMEDicare, P&S Healthcare, Sharon Services. Lot 4 sensor technology: Abena and Ontex only. £335m ex VAT. Bids received per lot: 9, 14, 9 and 2.
continence-bladder-and-bowel.use: Which lots each competitor can sell on. This settles the launch brief's own four-versus-seven lot contradiction: the award record has four.

continence-bladder-and-bowel.title: SBS10525 (successor to SBS10015): Lot 5 continence products home delivery
continence-bladder-and-bowel.fact: Lot 5 is 'Continence Products Home Delivery Service' (5a adult/bariatric, 5b paediatric). Estimated framework value £500m ex VAT across all lots. Tender closed 27/03/2026. SBS10015, the route almost every current England home-delivery award uses, expires 31/12/2026.
continence-bladder-and-bowel.use: Decides which suppliers trusts and ICBs can directly award home-delivery contracts to from 2027.

continence-bladder-and-bowel.title: Continence Goods and Services 2024
continence-bladder-and-bowel.fact: £100m total, £20m per lot. Lot 1 bulk: Abena, Critical Healthcare, iMEDicare, Medline, Essity, Vernacare, Ontex. Lot 2 home delivery: iMEDicare, Abena, Essity, Ontex.
continence-bladder-and-bowel.use: The second national route besides NHS SBS. NHS Wales used it for its 2025/26 direct award.

continence-bladder-and-bowel.title: Continence and home delivery (via SBS10015)
continence-bladder-and-bowel.quote: ESSITY Continence and Home Delivery - SBS10015
continence-bladder-and-bowel.use: Incumbent and end date: when this contract comes back round.

continence-bladder-and-bowel.title: Continence home delivery (SBS framework further competition, Lot 2)
continence-bladder-and-bowel.quote: further competition utilising Shared Business Services Framework … Lot 2 Continence Home Delivery Provision
continence-bladder-and-bowel.use: Incumbent and end date.

continence-bladder-and-bowel.title: Continence products and home delivery
continence-bladder-and-bowel.fact: Awarded to Essity UK Ltd, £5,756,406, 01/12/2023 to 30/11/2026.
continence-bladder-and-bowel.use: Ends within months: watch for the re-procurement notice.

continence-bladder-and-bowel.org: Rotherham Doncaster & South Humber NHS FT (RDaSH)

continence-bladder-and-bowel.quote: Risk to patients changing the products they use

continence-bladder-and-bowel.org: North Cumbria Integrated Care NHS FT
continence-bladder-and-bowel.title: Continence products: Abena contract extended ahead of a joint mini-competition
continence-bladder-and-bowel.fact: Originally awarded to Abena UK Limited in December 2017, extended to 30/04/2026 (£607,547 ex VAT). A joint procurement with the South Cumbria and Lancashire Provider Collaborative Board, by mini-competition on SBS10015, was planned for Q1 2026/27. Its outcome is not verified.
continence-bladder-and-bowel.use: A live or just-closed opportunity in the North West.

continence-bladder-and-bowel.quote: Supply of continence products in the community and a managed delivery service to homes and care homes
continence-bladder-and-bowel.use: History of who held the contract.

continence-bladder-and-bowel.title: NP571/22 Supply and Delivery of Continence Products
continence-bladder-and-bowel.fact: Lot 1 continence products and Lot 2 washable garments both awarded to Ontex Healthcare UK Ltd. The notice gives £15.2m ex VAT as the total value of the procurement; the same £15.2m figure is repeated against each lot, so it is the total, not a per-lot value, and the lots are not added together.
continence-bladder-and-bowel.quote: based on prescription data received via the Community Continence Nursing Service
continence-bladder-and-bowel.use: Scotland is a single-supplier national contract: one award decides the whole country.

continence-bladder-and-bowel.title: NP571/17 Continence Pads & Garments (the previous Scottish contract)
continence-bladder-and-bowel.fact: Awarded to a group of three suppliers: Paul Hartmann Ltd, Ontex Healthcare UK Ltd and SCA Hygiene. The 2022 modification extended it by up to 12 months, to 31/03/2023, citing Covid-19 demand. Initial estimated value £72m; total value after the modification £85,519,915 ex VAT.
continence-bladder-and-bowel.quote: The contract/concession has been awarded to a group of economic operators: Yes
continence-bladder-and-bowel.use: Who held Scotland before NP571/22: Paul Hartmann and SCA Hygiene (whose hygiene business is now Essity) shared it with Ontex, and Ontex then took both lots of the replacement contract.

continence-bladder-and-bowel.org: NHS Wales (Hywel Dda UHB board paper)
continence-bladder-and-bowel.title: All Wales continence products contract
continence-bladder-and-bowel.fact: The All Wales contract expired 31/05/2025. A 12-month direct award went to Ontex Healthcare UK Ltd on the HealthTrust Europe framework, 01/06/2025 to 31/05/2026, while a mini-competition ran for the long-term requirement. Hywel Dda's share is £988,043.42 ex VAT a year. The paper puts raw material cost increases at about 3.4%.
continence-bladder-and-bowel.use: Wales buys nationally too. Who won from June 2026 is not verified; a Sell2Wales award notice would settle it.

continence-bladder-and-bowel.title: WHC/2022/003 Adult continence products
continence-bladder-and-bowel.fact: Welsh Health Circular setting the all-Wales approach to adult continence product provision.
continence-bladder-and-bowel.quote: should not normally need to exceed 4 in 24
continence-bladder-and-bowel.use: The rationing rule a rep meets in every Welsh health board.

continence-bladder-and-bowel.title: Incontinence products: free after public health nurse assessment
continence-bladder-and-bowel.fact: HSE supplies incontinence products free of charge after assessment by the patient's public health nurse. The national storage and distribution tender (HSE 23739, €25m estimate, 2024) is on eTenders; who won it is not verified.
continence-bladder-and-bowel.use: The Republic of Ireland route is PHN-assessed, not prescribed.

continence-bladder-and-bowel.title: Continence pads provision consultation
continence-bladder-and-bowel.fact: Spend on continence pads was about £2.1m against a budget of about £1.3m. Proposals: stop supplying lower-absorbency pads such as TENA Comfort Mini Super, move to a 16-week delivery cycle, and cut four pads to three per 24 hours.
continence-bladder-and-bowel.quote: readily available online and in a variety of stores
continence-bladder-and-bowel.use: Primary evidence that NHS rationing is pushing light incontinence into private pay.

continence-bladder-and-bowel.title: Containment product home delivery service
continence-bladder-and-bowel.fact: Names TENA as the product brand and NHS Supply Chain as the distributor, on a 20-week delivery cycle.
continence-bladder-and-bowel.quote: NHS Supply Chain are the distributor
continence-bladder-and-bowel.use: A trust using the NHS Supply Chain home-delivery route rather than a SBS contract.

continence-bladder-and-bowel.org: Birmingham & Solihull Mental Health NHS FT
continence-bladder-and-bowel.title: Continence Resource Folder, July 2024
continence-bladder-and-bowel.fact: Inpatient pad formulary of TENA (Comfort, Flex, Pants, Men) and Attends Stretch Pants, with NHS order codes and a working price per piece, e.g. TENA Comfort Normal CFP2146 at 11p and Attends Stretch Pants Medium CFP1563 at 29p. Prices are July 2024 and not necessarily today's.
continence-bladder-and-bowel.use: A published per-piece reference price on the ward route.

continence-bladder-and-bowel.title: Continence Product Formulary: Adult Community
continence-bladder-and-bowel.fact: Lists iD (Ontex) products only, consistent with the single-supplier national contract.

continence-bladder-and-bowel.title: QS77 Urinary incontinence in women
continence-bladder-and-bowel.fact: Statement 3: containment products only as a temporary coping strategy, or as long-term management if treatment is unsuccessful.
continence-bladder-and-bowel.quote: only offered containment products as a temporary coping strategy
continence-bladder-and-bowel.use: The national basis behind local rationing.

continence-bladder-and-bowel.title: QS54 Faecal incontinence in adults
continence-bladder-and-bowel.fact: Statement 3: adults are offered a choice of appropriate products for as long as they experience episodes.
continence-bladder-and-bowel.use: A counter-argument to single-brand pad contracts.

continence-bladder-and-bowel.title: Care homes and estimating the self-funding population, 2022 to 2023
continence-bladder-and-bowel.fact: About 137,480 care home residents (37.0%) were self-funders.
continence-bladder-and-bowel.quote: approximately, 137,480 (37.0%) of care home residents were classified as self-funders
continence-bladder-and-bowel.use: The only official private-pay care home indicator found.

tissue-viability-and-wound-care.title: Wound Care Management Joint Formulary 2025
tissue-viability-and-wound-care.fact: The change log records Zetuvit and Eclypse removed and replaced with ConvaMax. HydroClean Advance and Atrauman remain listed.
tissue-viability-and-wound-care.quote: Removal of Zetuvits and Eclypse dressings to be replaced with Convamax
tissue-viability-and-wound-care.use: A named formulary switch between competitors.

tissue-viability-and-wound-care.title: Wound Care Formulary, September 2025
tissue-viability-and-wound-care.fact: Lists RespoSorb Silicone Border in seven sizes with NHS Supply Chain codes (e.g. EJA254), Atrauman and Cosmopor. Under compression it names Kliniderm Superabsorbent and RespoSorb Silicone Border.
tissue-viability-and-wound-care.quote: This August 2025 edition replaces the previous February
tissue-viability-and-wound-care.use: Which brands are on formulary, with order codes.

tissue-viability-and-wound-care.org: Oxford Health NHS FT and Oxford University Hospitals
tissue-viability-and-wound-care.title: Wound Formulary Comparison Guidance V2, November 2025
tissue-viability-and-wound-care.fact: Maps community products to their acute equivalents, e.g. community Kliniderm Foam Silicone Border against acute RespoSorb Silicone Border. Zetuvit Plus, Atrauman and Cosmopor E also appear.
tissue-viability-and-wound-care.use: Shows where a patient's dressing changes between hospital and community in one ICB.

tissue-viability-and-wound-care.title: Wound Care Formulary by setting (webinar pack, July 2025)
tissue-viability-and-wound-care.fact: Split by setting (GP, community nursing, care homes, tissue viability specialists). Zetuvit E is the basic absorbent in all four; RespoSorb Silicone and Zetuvit Plus appear in the tissue viability specialist column. HydroClean Advance, Atrauman and Cosmopor E are listed.

tissue-viability-and-wound-care.title: Community Dressing Formulary 2025 V3
tissue-viability-and-wound-care.fact: Lists RespoSorb Silicone (and Border), Zetuvit, Zetuvit Plus Silicone, Atrauman Ag, Cosmopor E and HydroClean.
tissue-viability-and-wound-care.quote: Approved by Tissue Viability October 2025 – Review 2027

tissue-viability-and-wound-care.title: Wound Management Formulary V6.1
tissue-viability-and-wound-care.fact: Lists HydroClean Advance debridement dressing and Atrauman (HARTMANN) with PIP codes. Kliniderm is named throughout.
tissue-viability-and-wound-care.use: Review due within weeks: the moment to be in front of the formulary group.

tissue-viability-and-wound-care.title: Joint Wound Care Formulary
tissue-viability-and-wound-care.fact: Atrauman is the only HARTMANN line. The superabsorbent is KerraMax Care.

tissue-viability-and-wound-care.title: Wound Management Guidelines and Formulary v2.7
tissue-viability-and-wound-care.fact: Names Kliniderm Super Absorbent as first-line choice. No HARTMANN product named.

tissue-viability-and-wound-care.org: NHS Shared Business Services with NHS Supply Chain
tissue-viability-and-wound-care.title: SBS10518 Distribution of Advanced Wound Care
tissue-viability-and-wound-care.fact: A joint NHS SBS and NHS Supply Chain procurement renewing part of the Advanced Wound Care and Lymphoedema agreement (SBS10142). £91,000,000 ex VAT. Tender period ended 24/04/2026. Award not yet verified.
tissue-viability-and-wound-care.quote: This is a renewal of part of an existing NHS SBS agreement
tissue-viability-and-wound-care.use: Decides how advanced wound care products reach community settings from 2027.

tissue-viability-and-wound-care.title: SBS10142 Advanced Wound Care and Lymphoedema: extension
tissue-viability-and-wound-care.ends: 01/08/2026 per this notice; NHS SBS's own page says 01/08/2027
tissue-viability-and-wound-care.fact: A 12-month extension on existing terms to 01/08/2026, while NHS SBS collaborates with other framework hosts on the next generation of the agreement. No Find a Tender notice for a further year to 2027 was found.
tissue-viability-and-wound-care.quote: a 12 month extension on existing terms, bringing the end date to 1 August 2026
tissue-viability-and-wound-care.use: Why the SBS renewal is late, and why the end date needs checking before quoting.

tissue-viability-and-wound-care.title: Advanced Wound Care award
tissue-viability-and-wound-care.fact: Two lots: 30 suppliers on Lot 1 and 56 on Lot 2, which is 59 distinct names. Absorbest, Advanced Medical Solutions and GBUK appear only in Lot 1. Paul Hartmann Ltd is awarded. The launch brief states 56 suppliers, which does not reconcile with the 59 distinct names on this award notice.
tissue-viability-and-wound-care.use: Reconciles the supplier count: 59 distinct companies across both lots.

tissue-viability-and-wound-care.title: Surgical Dressings
tissue-viability-and-wound-care.fact: £56.1m ex VAT across 11 lots, e.g. Securement & Dressings £14,584,364 and single-use NPWT systems £6,977,241. Who won is not verified.
tissue-viability-and-wound-care.use: Northern Ireland market size by lot.

tissue-viability-and-wound-care.title: Wound Management framework
tissue-viability-and-wound-care.fact: £28,339,827 estimated, with lots including alginates, hydrogels, hydrocolloids and absorbent fibre. No award notice found on Find a Tender; winners not verified.

tissue-viability-and-wound-care.title: Drug Tariff Part IX categorisation, Wave 2 (Wound and skin care) v2.0
tissue-viability-and-wound-care.fact: Assigns every wound product to a cluster for the Wave 2 review, e.g. 'Superabsorbent dressing, with silicone wound contact layer, adhesive', 'Hydro-responsive dressing' and 'Low adherent silicone permeable wound contact layer'.
tissue-viability-and-wound-care.quote: Newly added clusters are highlighted yellow
tissue-viability-and-wound-care.use: Tells a supplier which cluster each product will be benchmarked in when Wave 2 renewals open.

tissue-viability-and-wound-care.title: Spend over £25,000, 2026 (January to August)
tissue-viability-and-wound-care.fact: Across 3,888 rows, 154 payments to NHS Supply Chain total about £72.5m (all categories). There is no Paul Hartmann payment at £25k or more, and one TJ Smith & Nephew line (£28,572.89, February 2026).
tissue-viability-and-wound-care.use: Acute dressing spend flows through NHS Supply Chain, so trust spend files understate each manufacturer's acute share.
